title: featureDelivery
responsibility: Validates delivery receipts and derives project listing, storage and playback addresses.

inputs.name: featureDeliveryPrefix.project
inputs.description: The canonical Tracker project label, prior to URI encoding.

inputs.name: featureDeliveryReceiptKey.value
inputs.description: The validated receipt supplying the project, delivery date, item ID and release stage.

inputs.name: featureDeliverySource.value
inputs.description: The full Tracker item ID and SHA-256 of the recording named by the playback URL.

inputs.name: featureDeliveryVideoKey.id
inputs.description: The validated full Tracker item ID.

inputs.name: featureDeliveryVideoKey.sha256
inputs.description: The lowercase SHA-256 of the recording bytes.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryStages
outputs.description: The dev, staging and live delivery stages in release order.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryStage
outputs.description: The validator that accepts one supported delivery stage.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryId
outputs.description: The validator for lowercase alphanumeric Tracker IDs between six and 64 characters.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryDigest
outputs.description: The validator for a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 digest.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryProject
outputs.description: The validator for a nonempty project name up to 200 characters with no slash or control character.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryDuration
outputs.description: The validator for a recording duration between 20 and 60 seconds, inclusive.

outputs.name: featureDeliverySchema
outputs.description: The strict schema for a delivery receipt with a clip digest and millisecond-precision delivery date.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryPageSchema
outputs.description: The strict schema for up to 12 delivery receipts and a nullable continuation cursor.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryApi
outputs.description: The owner-authenticated relative endpoint for delivery listings and playback.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryPrefix
outputs.description: The private evidence bucket prefix used to list the receipts for one project.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryReceiptKey
outputs.description: The project-scoped JSON receipt key ordered by newest delivery first.

outputs.name: featureDeliverySource
outputs.description: The relative owner-only playback URL with encoded item ID and digest.

outputs.name: featureDeliveryVideoKey
outputs.description: The private evidence bucket key for the original WebM bytes.
